name: Orang Bati
description: A reported winged humanoid creature from Seram Island in the Maluku (Molucca) Islands of eastern Indonesia, described as approximately five feet tall with bat-like black wings and red skin, said to emerge from caves on Mount Kairatu to abduct children from remote villages at night.
origin: Reported exclusively from Seram Island (Ceram), Maluku (Molucca) Islands, eastern Indonesia. The creature is specifically associated with the interior mountains, particularly Mount Kairatu (Gunung Binaiya).
